derivedFacts: `Document.body` is documented to answer null or nothing
the answer's type does not state that it can be absent
nothing tests the answer before it is dereferenced

presentations.more: `Document.body` is documented to answer nothing in ordinary conditions — an unset variable, the end of a stream, a path that is not there — and the type this function sees does not say so, so the compiler lets it dereference the answer unchecked. When the answer is absent, the first member access throws. Test the answer, or supply a default, before using it.

specs.description: `runtime.mjs` — Runtime. This project's call graph records DIRECT calls only, so a function passed to a container, destructured into an exported binding, or reached through a dynamic lookup is not one it can see. Within that limit it records no call to this module. At run time it reaches `core` and `panel`. Can fail: “`rejectPath` can fail with the error `Error`.” 1 requirement: 1 violated. 1 stated failure.
